texts.li: [spring,!station] Spring brings {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} up the road with a stool on {X_possessive} back, cutting winter's growth off everyone between the towns and the hills. {X_pronoun} has set up by the gate. Those who want a cut: {TALE}.

[industrial|spacer,!station] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has unfolded a barber's chair from a case on wheels by the gate and plugged in nothing at all: scissors and a comb, {X_pronoun} says, the way it should be done. Those who'd like a cut: {TALE}.

[station,lowtech] {X_nameDef}, a barber of {FACTION}, stopped dead at the sight of the colony's styling station and asked whether {X_pronoun} might work beside it for the day. Those who'd like a cut: {TALE}.

lines.li: Everyone took a turn on {X_nameDef}'s stool, and the gate is ankle deep in hair. {X_nameDef} talked the whole day and seems to know everyone's business now.
Those who wanted a cut sat for {X_nameDef} one after another, and came away looking like new people. The rest watched, and one or two looked sorry by the end.
{X_nameDef} wiped the shears, packed the combs away in their cloth and went on to the next settlement.

texts.li: [hurt,!lowtech] {X_nameDef}, a veterinarian of {FACTION} riding with their drovers, leaned on the colony's fence for a long minute and then asked who had been looking after {TALE}. {X_pronoun} offers to see to them, with medicine of {X_possessive} own, for {COUNT} silver or a load of feed for the drovers' beasts.

[hurt,winter] Winter is hard on animals, {X_nameDef} says, and {X_pronoun} would know: {X_pronoun} doctors {FACTION}'s herds, and has stopped at the gate on the way to the next village. {X_pronoun} offers to see to {TALE}, for {COUNT} silver or feed for the drovers' beasts.

[nohurt,young] {X_nameDef}, an animal doctor of {FACTION}, has been watching {PET_nameDef} from the gate and laughing. There is a good animal in there, {X_pronoun} says, if someone takes the time. {X_pronoun} would work {PET_objective} a morning, for {COUNT} silver or feed for the drovers' beasts.

lines.li: [hurt] {X_nameDef} knelt by each hurt and sick animal in turn with a bag of salves and a steady voice, and left every one of them better than {X_pronoun} found it.
[hurt] {X_nameDef} saw to the colony's animals one after another, then loaded the feed onto the drovers' beasts and went after them.
{X_nameDef} tended the hurt and the sick by lantern light, and slept in the corner the colony gave {X_objective}, and was gone by morning.
{X_nameDef} said the animals would mend in their own time, and went to catch up with the drovers.

texts.li: [!nobeast,industrial|spacer] A burial detail of {FACTION} came up the road with shovels, sheets and a pack beast, and {X_nameDef}, who leads it, asked to see to the raiders lying by the colony. Graves beyond the wall for {COUNT} silver, or they take the dead away with everything on them for nothing.

[!nobeast,summer] The dead won't wait in this heat, {X_nameDef} says. {X_pronoun} leads a burial order of {FACTION}, and has come to the gate to see to the raiders still lying out. Graves beyond the wall for {COUNT} silver, or the order takes them away, gear and all, for nothing.

[nobeast,lowtech] The ash-keepers of {FACTION} have come, as they do wherever the dead lie unburied, with {X_nameDef} at their head and spades on their shoulders. They will dig a grave for each of the raiders beyond the wall for {COUNT} silver.

lines.li: {X_nameDef}'s people dug steadily all afternoon beyond the gate and laid each raider in a grave of their own. {X_nameDef} said a few words over them that nobody else understood.
The undertakers loaded the dead onto their beast one by one, with whatever the raiders had carried, and led it off down the road without looking back.
{X_nameDef} shrugged, as if {X_pronoun} had heard that before, and the order went on down the road.

texts.li: [prisoner,winter] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, {TALE}'s {RELATION}, came through the snow to the gate with {X_possessive} partner and {COUNT} silver in a knotted cloth. They have come for {TALE}, or at least to speak with {TALE} through the door.

[prisoner,!lowtech] {X_nameDef}, {TALE}'s {RELATION}, has come to the gate from {FACTION} with {X_possessive} partner and an envelope with {COUNT} silver in it. They read the colony's name in a list of where the raiders were taken, and have come for {TALE}.

[slave,lowtech] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, {TALE}'s {RELATION}, stands at the gate with {X_possessive} partner and {COUNT} silver, all they could sell their goats for. They have come to take {TALE} home.

lines.li: The silver changed hands at the gate, and {TALE} walked out to {X_nameDef}, who held on and didn't say anything for a long time. They went home together.
The colony sent the family home with their silver and with {TALE}. {X_nameDef} turned at the bend in the road to look back at the gate.
{X_nameDef} talked with {TALE} through the cell door until the light went, mostly about home. {TALE} has been quieter since.
The family was sent away from the gate. {TALE} watched them go from the window, and has dug in since.

texts.li: [maker,industrial|spacer] {X_nameDef}, who buys art for a gallery of {FACTION}, has photographed every piece the colony owns and come back to stand in front of one: "{TALE}", the {THING} {A_nameDef} made. {X_pronoun} offers {COUNT} silver for it, well over what any trader would pay.

[!maker,winter] {X_nameDef}, a collector of {FACTION}, came through the cold for the colony's art and has been walking round it with {X_possessive} coat still on. "{TALE}" has caught {X_possessive} eye, and {X_pronoun} offers {COUNT} silver for it, well above its worth.

lines.li: The {THING} was carried out to {X_nameDef}, who counted out the {COUNT} silver and wrapped "{TALE}" in three layers of cloth before {X_pronoun} would let anyone touch it again.
{X_nameDef} stood a long while in front of "{TALE}" before {X_pronoun} went, and said {X_pronoun} would tell people about it, which is almost as good as owning it.
{B_nameDef} sat down at the sculptor's table for {X_nameDef}, who went on down the road saying {X_pronoun} would be back for it, and meant it.
